integrity_binding.reason: The mutually referencing planning artifacts cannot safely embed one another's final hashes.

status_semantics.blocked: Packet-local only; it does not imply that the thread goal is blocked.
status_semantics.prerequisite_rule: A normal prerequisite must be gate_passed; G0 means both G0-U and G0-E have valid decision receipts.
status_semantics.completion_claim_rule: Only Z0-P1 may set claims.product_complete to true; active shared-goal completion is a separate conjunction with current SBE gates.

packet_contract.matrix_contributes_to_semantics: Design, fixture, spike, implementation, or supporting evidence only; it never closes a completion row.
packet_contract.matrix_closes_semantics: The packet is the exclusive planned closure owner, but closure is derived only from bound validation receipts in gate mode.
packet_contract.shared_file_rule: A path may have one active owner at a time even when two packets use the same broad ownership lane.
packet_contract.cross_catalog_rule: Exact path ownership, pre-edit hashes, owner, lease, and external prerequisites must be checked against both this catalog and the current SBE ownership/status snapshot; approval never grants file ownership.
packet_contract.external_prerequisite_rule: Every listed external prerequisite must have a fresh signed or hash-bound handoff receipt before in_progress; it is not inferred from approval or an apparently idle STATUS row.
packet_contract.hot_shared_contract_rule: A packet writes only its predeclared evidence/checkpoint file. AGENTS.md, shared STATUS.md, SBE traceability, and other hot contracts are read-only unless a separately predeclared status/contract integrator owns that exact update.
packet_contract.protected_change_rule: Live knowledge/, user_data/, .runtime/, existing per-user Notion databases, existing 10111 preview roots, and production roots are never pytest fixtures or writable automated-test targets. Separately approved operator actions may use an offline production copy or named production scope; protected source changes additionally require exact ownership and the active owning SBE packet.

ownership_lanes.DOC_HARNESS: Plans, catalogs, verifiers, runners, receipts, and tests; same-file ownership is exclusive.
ownership_lanes.RUNTIME: Pair configuration, launchers, app boundary, cookies, origin, CSRF, health, and service lifecycle; app_code.py requires explicit ownership transfer.
ownership_lanes.CANONICAL: Workspace store, forward schema lineage, migrations, authoritative commands, events, epochs, audit, and outbox; one active owner.
ownership_lanes.UI: notion.js, notion.css, index.html, editor core, host adapter, and browser-facing behavior; one active owner.
ownership_lanes.SECOND_BRAIN_PRODUCTION: Protected Second Brain or production paths; explicit ownership transfer, approval where applicable, and full SBE regression.
ownership_lanes.SPIKE: Disposable isolated candidates only; no production dependency or frozen schema before the winner decision.

approval_registry.scope: Approved dev identity allowlist, new roots and secret/cookie namespace, replacement of development 10111, and start of 10112/10113.
Download or install an unavailable CRDT, ASGI, Node, or gateway candidate only in the isolated spike environment.
Create, mutate, capture, and clean synthetic multi-user states in the dedicated external Notion reference workspaces.
Configure the external encrypted backup destination, key, retention, and target-host restore drill.
Create and use an approved offline production-data copy; no production mutation.
Install the frozen release and gateway at 10012 default-off, restart owned services, and run health checks without user enablement.
Enable the frozen generation for named canary principals and workspace under abort thresholds.
Execute a real production restore after an incident; rehearsal never grants this authority.

external_gate_registry.rule: Re-read AGENTS.md and its ordered 18-document SBE preflight, bind their manifest plus runtime goal/status/schema observations, and fail closed on drift or conflict. Runtime goal state governs; any disagreement with STATUS.md is preserved and later reconciled only by the assigned status integrator.

D0B-P1 and SBE-7.2 may not concurrently own or replace 10111, its launcher, auth/config composition, roots, services, or ports. One side must provide an exact-path/hash/service-state handoff receipt to the other.
S0B-P1 may exist only after S0A-P1 proves necessity, an active SBE packet explicitly owns every protected path and v8-v11 migration, and its rollout dependency gate accepts the change.

Target load, backup/restore, production service, 10011/10012, canary, and rollout work requires one coordinated target-authority owner and a fresh cross-stream handoff; no Notion receipt may close an SBE target gate or vice versa.

goal_completion_contract.active_shared_goal_complete_when: Z0-P1_gate_passed AND current TEST_OPERATIONS.md gates AND current TRACEABILITY.md gates AND current GOAL_CONTRACT.json scenarios

phase_gates.exit: Draft capability denominator, authority inventory, catalogs, audit/gate modes, and tamper tests are complete; final product choices remain open at G0-U.
The approved 10111/10112 pair shares only the intended dev identity authority and is isolated from production roots, cookies, secrets, origins, CSRF, logout, links, and requests.
Owner, member, internal page guest, and outsider run in independent ephemeral browser contexts with deterministic reset and leak oracles.
One content/IAM/event authority has no request-time directory scan or dual write and passes migration, restart, replay, revocation, and rollback rehearsal.
A pinned Windows-reproducible gateway/CRDT winner passes the common convergence, Korean IME, restart, compaction, fault, and cost corpus.
Ticket, epoch, sequence, ACK, replay, snapshot, compaction, backpressure, restart, and revoke behavior is durable and fail-closed.
The selected update/snapshot format shares one high-water boundary with a coordinated synthetic backup and reproducible new-root restore.
A narrow host adapter is the only supported collaboration hook and preserves all six Node contracts plus the historical browser journey.
All new capabilities are default-off, the aggregate switch dominates capability switches, and code rollback never requires schema downgrade.
Workspace roles and page grants, inheritance, invitation, role change, revoke, audit, and outsider non-oracles pass across independent principals.
Presence, comments, reactions, mentions, and inbox are durable or explicitly ephemeral, permission-filtered, revoke-fenced, and proven in two browsers.
Rich text, structure, and adopted database mutations converge with zero acknowledged character loss while IME, selection, focus, undo, reconnect, and offline recovery pass.
Only an explicit canonical revision publication commit enters Second Brain and stale approval, revoke, retry, restart, search, backlink, and session paths remain authorized.
Every adopted database, file, history, search, import/export, reminder, and adjacent capability round-trips canonically; non-adopted visible controls are absent.

The final candidate reruns Core 25 and every adopted multi-user state at both viewports with reviewed strict visual similarity across the full viewport, three broad regions, and one state-specific critical region; exact candidate RGBA remains diagnostic, the immutable V0R reference transport remains exact, and accessibility evidence is complete.
One coordinated encrypted generation restores to a new root with permissions, realtime, files, history, search, and Second Brain checks inside the frozen RPO/RTO.
Frozen load, fault, security, accessibility, observability, and kill-switch envelopes pass with no acknowledged-operation loss or authorization leak.
Production-copy rehearsal, restored-copy full suite, compatible rollback, default-off install, gateway packaging, restart, and health checks pass.
Two collaborators and one outsider pass canary, soak, abort, prebuilt kill-switch exercise, rollback, and recovery checks on the frozen generation.
All completion rows, gates, approvals, receipts, artifacts, realm derivations, hashes, and deployment bindings pass strict mode with no skip, xfail, open decision, or unresolved host retry.

subgates.schema_version_rule: Derive from the current migration lineage under an exclusive CANONICAL lease; never ask the user to choose a schema number.
